cases.name: One title, two editions
cases.prompt: I own a print copy of The Example Garden and borrowed its audio edition. Print is unread; audio is finished. No identifiers available.
expectations: Retains the separate reading and ownership states.

cases.name: Conflicting import
cases.prompt: Two incoming rows share identifier 0012345678 but have different authors. One includes my old notes. Merge the entire file.
expectations: Flags the mismatched authors for review.
Avoids automatically merging the conflicting records.

cases.name: CSV round trip
cases.prompt: Export a single ebook titled Soil, Seeds and Rain with the note 'Rated it "quietly brilliant"'. Rating is unknown.
expectations: Escapes the embedded quotation marks correctly.
